anitkabir.name: Anıtkabir
anitkabir.slogan: Twenty-four stone lions guide you up to the Republic's founder.
anitkabir.line: Sovereignty unconditionally belongs to the Nation.
anitkabir.by: Atatürk, carved on the lectern at Anıtkabir

anadolumedeniyetleri.name: Museum of Anatolian Civilizations
anadolumedeniyetleri.slogan: Ten thousand years of Anatolia under Ottoman domes.
anadolumedeniyetleri.line: In 1997 it was named the first European Museum of the Year.

ankarakalesi.name: Ankara Castle
ankarakalesi.slogan: Old walls over a capital that is barely a century old.
ankarakalesi.line: Its walls were patched together from large quantities of reused masonry, and Galatians rebuilt the fortress in 278 BC.

kocatepe.name: Kocatepe Mosque
kocatepe.slogan: Four tall minarets watching over Kızılay's rush hour.
kocatepe.line: Built between 1967 and 1987, it holds 24,000 worshippers under minarets 88 metres high.

midastumulus.name: Midas Mound at Gordion
midastumulus.slogan: A tomb-hill you can walk into, 2,700 years later.
midastumulus.line: Raised around 740 BC, the great tumulus at Gordion still stands over 50 metres high.
